Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 assays against human single-protein target CHEMBL1641348. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary, and join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1641348, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order results by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id. Do not deduplicate.
